winnerScript:
HOOK
VO: I just dumped out my sock drawer and found fourteen socks with no partner. Fourteen.
ON-SCREEN: 14 orphan socks 😩
VISUAL: Creator flips a drawer upside down onto the bed; mismatched socks spill everywhere.

PAIN
VO: Every laundry day the machine eats one of each pair, and I end up at work in one black sock and one navy one.
ON-SCREEN: the laundry ate it. again.
VISUAL: Close-up of mismatched ankles under an office desk.

SOLUTION
VO: So I switched to SockLock. There's a little magnet in each cuff.
ON-SCREEN: magnets in the cuffs 🧲
VISUAL: Macro shot of two cuffs snapping together with an audible click.

DEMO
VO: Take them off, click them together, throw them in the wash. They come out still a pair.
ON-SCREEN: click → wash → still paired
VISUAL: Socks clicked together, tossed in the washer, pulled out of the drum still attached. (3 quick cuts)

PROOF
VO: It's been a month. Not one orphan sock.
ON-SCREEN: 1 month. 0 orphans.
VISUAL: Slow push-in on a drawer of neatly paired socks.

OFFER
VO: Your first box is five pairs for twenty-nine dollars, then fresh pairs show up every quarter.
ON-SCREEN: 5 pairs · $29
VISUAL: Unboxing five pairs on the bed.

CTA
VO: Tap the link and lock your pairs together.
ON-SCREEN: Lock your pairs →
VISUAL: Creator holds a clicked pair up to camera.

competitor.title: FoldFast — “POV: Sunday laundry” UGC ad (fictional sample)
competitor.summary: A first-person UGC ad that turns a universal chore into a relatable ‘pile of shame’, quantifies the time it wastes, then proves the product with an uncut timed demo and a witness reaction. The offer leans on a strikethrough discount and scarcity.
competitor.primaryAngle: Reclaim the time a weekly chore steals from you
competitor.storytellingPattern: POV relatable moment → quantified pain → reluctant discovery → real-time proof → witness reaction → offer → loop
competitor.targetAudience: Busy 22–40 renters and young families who dread laundry day

observed.spokenText: POV: it's Sunday and this is your bed.
observed.visualDescription: Locked-off top-down shot of a bed buried under clean, unfolded laundry. Hard punch-in zoom at ~1.2s. A hand drops one more shirt onto the pile.
observed.audioNotes: Lo-fi beat drops on the first cut; deadpan female voice-over.

interpretation.reusablePattern: Open on an exaggerated top-down ‘pile of shame’ of [PAIN] in its natural habitat, with a POV caption naming the exact moment ([DAY/TIME]) it happens.
interpretation.evidence: 0.0–2.8s: top-down overloaded bed with caption ‘POV: Sunday 6pm’; punch-in at ~1.2s; extra shirt dropped at 2.1s.

observed.spokenText: Forty minutes of folding, and by Wednesday the drawer looks like a crime scene again.
observed.visualDescription: Five fast cuts in ~5s: creator sighs, a badly folded shirt, a drawer forced shut, a phone stopwatch reading 40:12, the drawer messy again.
observed.audioNotes: Ticking-clock SFX layered under the beat.

interpretation.angle: Time wasted on a chore that undoes itself
interpretation.reusablePattern: Put a hard, recurring number on [PAIN] as an on-screen caption and show the problem ‘resetting’ so the futility is visible.
interpretation.evidence: Caption ‘40 min. Every. Week.’ at 3.1s; stopwatch close-up 40:12 at 6.9s; ticking SFX from 2.8s.

observed.spokenText: Then my sister sent me this.
observed.visualDescription: Whip-pan transition; a hand slides the folding board into frame from the right and drops it on the cleared bed.
observed.audioNotes: Beat switch to a brighter track; ‘thunk’ SFX as the board lands.

interpretation.mechanism: Skeptical discovery (question instead of claim) + trusted-person referral
interpretation.angle: Found it through someone I trust
interpretation.storytellingPattern: Problem → discovery pivot on a beat switch
interpretation.reusablePattern: Pivot from [PAIN] to [PRODUCT] on a whip-pan with an audible ‘landing’ SFX and a skeptical question caption instead of a claim.
interpretation.evidence: Whip-pan at 8.5s; caption ends in a question mark; music changes at 8.6s; ‘thunk’ at 9.4s.

observed.spokenText: Flip, flip, fold. That's it. Watch — I'm timing it.
observed.visualDescription: Overhead locked-off shot. One uncut real-time take folding a T-shirt in ~3s (12.0–15.2s), then a 4× speed ramp through a whole stack. A timer overlay counts up continuously.

interpretation.mechanism: Demonstration-as-proof: uncut take + live timer signals ‘nothing is edited’
interpretation.reusablePattern: Prove [PRODUCT]'s core mechanic in one uncut real-time take with a live on-screen timer, then speed-ramp the repetition; mix the mechanic's sound loud.
interpretation.evidence: No cuts between 12.0s and 15.2s; timer overlay visible throughout; 4× ramp from 15.2s; fold SFX on every fold.

observed.spokenText: (Roommate, off-camera) Wait, you folded all of that? (Creator) Eight minutes.
observed.onScreenText: 40 min → 8 min · 2M views on my last video lol
observed.visualDescription: Split screen: left, the Sunday pile; right, a neatly stacked drawer. The roommate leans into frame looking surprised.
observed.audioNotes: Record-scratch SFX on the roommate's line.

interpretation.mechanism: Before/after contrast + third-party witness reaction; view-count social proof
interpretation.reusablePattern: Split-screen before/after with a ‘from → to’ caption, and let an off-camera witness voice the disbelief instead of the creator claiming it.
interpretation.evidence: Split screen from 21.5s; caption ‘40 min → 8 min’; roommate line at 22.3s; ‘2M views’ overlay at 24.0s.

observed.spokenText: They're doing fifty percent off right now — it was sixty, now it's thirty.
observed.visualDescription: Product on a pastel backdrop; a price card animates in with a strikethrough on $60.
observed.audioNotes: Cash-register SFX on the price reveal.

interpretation.reusablePattern: State the offer in one breath on a single animated price card, synced to a confirmation SFX.
interpretation.evidence: Strikethrough price card at 26.8s; ‘50% OFF’ caption; ‘right now’ in the VO.

observed.spokenText: Link's in my bio before they sell out again. Comment ‘FOLD’ and I'll send it.
observed.visualDescription: Creator points down toward the comments. The final frame cuts back to the opening top-down pile, so the video loops seamlessly.
observed.audioNotes: Beat ends on a downbeat that lines up with the loop start.

interpretation.storytellingPattern: Loop ending (last frame matches the first)
interpretation.reusablePattern: End by cutting back to the exact opening frame so the video loops, paired with a one-word comment CTA.
interpretation.evidence: Pointing gesture at 31.0s; the last frame (33.6s) visually matches the 0.0s frame; caption ‘Comment FOLD’.

techniques.name: POV pile-of-shame cold open
techniques.description: Top-down shot of the problem at its worst, labeled with the exact moment it happens.
techniques.howToReuse: Shoot [PAIN] top-down in its natural habitat, punch in at ~1s, caption ‘POV: [moment the pain happens]’.

techniques.name: Quantified pain counter
techniques.description: A hard recurring number makes a vague annoyance feel like a real cost.
techniques.howToReuse: Caption the recurring cost of [PAIN] with a number the creator actually measured; show it reset or grow.

techniques.name: Whip-pan skeptical reveal
techniques.description: The product enters on a whip-pan and a ‘landing’ SFX, captioned with a question instead of a claim.
techniques.howToReuse: Whip-pan from [PAIN] to [PRODUCT] landing in frame; caption the reveal as a skeptical question.

techniques.name: Uncut demo with live timer
techniques.description: One continuous take with a running timer proves the mechanic isn't edited.
techniques.howToReuse: Film [PRODUCT]'s core action in a single uncut take with a live on-screen timer, then speed-ramp the repetitions.

techniques.name: ASMR mechanic sound
techniques.description: The product's physical sound is mixed loud as a satisfying signature.
techniques.evidence: Fold ‘snap’ SFX mixed above the music.
techniques.howToReuse: Close-mic the [PRODUCT]'s signature sound and mix it +6 dB above the music, on the beat.

techniques.name: Split-screen from→to + witness
techniques.description: Before/after side by side with the result as a ‘from → to’ caption; a bystander voices the surprise.
techniques.evidence: Split screen at 21.5s, ‘40 min → 8 min’, roommate line at 22.3s.
techniques.howToReuse: Split-screen [BEFORE] vs [AFTER]; caption ‘[before] → [after]’; an off-camera friend reacts to what's on screen.

techniques.name: Strikethrough price anchor + scarcity
techniques.description: Discount framed against a higher ‘was’ price, plus a ‘sell out’ warning.
techniques.howToReuse: Show [WAS PRICE] struck through next to [NOW PRICE] with an urgency line.

techniques.name: Seamless loop ending
techniques.description: The last frame matches the first, so the ad rewatches itself.
techniques.howToReuse: End on the exact composition of your opening frame; time the final beat to the loop point.

techniques.name: View-count social proof overlay
techniques.description: On-screen brag about past video views as implied credibility.
techniques.evidence: ‘2M views on my last video lol’ at 24.0s.
techniques.howToReuse: Overlay an audience number (views, buyers) as casual proof.

productBenefits: Folds a shirt in about 3 seconds (claimed)
Cuts weekly folding from 40 to 8 minutes (claimed)
